sessions.phase_label: Landing-page requirements, design revisions, deployment, and CTA configuration

requirements.title: Restaurant and Family Marketing Messaging
requirements.definition: Present the branded disposable kids' bib product as a marketing proposition for restaurants and fast-food chains, emphasizing its value for families and restaurant quality.
requirements.boundary_note: Product identity, target customers, and family and restaurant value are tightly coupled messaging attributes; visual imagery, video, access, and CTA behavior are independently changeable Requirements.

requirements.title: Non-Shopify Landing Page
requirements.definition: Provide the landing page without depending on Shopify, which the client does not use.
requirements.boundary_note: This records only the client-confirmed Shopify exclusion; WordPress, Elementor, and Netlify are not treated as client-confirmed platform choices.

requirements.title: Shareable Landing Page Link
requirements.definition: Deploy a complete landing page at a working link that the client can send to selected customers so they can view the product, without requiring a custom domain as part of the deliverable.
requirements.boundary_note: The evidence establishes link-mediated customer access and a working deployed page, not password authentication or another enforced authorization mechanism. Domain and hosting details are attributes of this delivery mechanism.

requirements.title: Child-Friendly Restaurant Visual Design
requirements.definition: Use an attractive, lively visual presentation featuring children, a restaurant atmosphere, client product pictures, and suitable upper-page imagery adapted from the supplied reference.
requirements.boundary_note: Theme, reference adaptation, product pictures, and image attractiveness form one visual-selection mechanism. Whether images technically render on the live page is independently testable and remains separate.

requirements.title: CTA External Redirect
requirements.definition: Configure the landing-page call-to-action button to redirect users to the external destination selected and supplied by the client.
requirements.boundary_note: CTA destination behavior can be clarified, changed, implemented, and verified independently of page deployment or any proposed contact form.

requirements.title: Landing Page Video
requirements.definition: Include the client-supplied video on the landing page.
requirements.boundary_note: Video inclusion has its own media asset and acceptance criterion and can change independently of static imagery and marketing copy.

requirements.title: Live Image Rendering
requirements.definition: Ensure the intended landing-page images display correctly on the live deployed page.
requirements.boundary_note: This functional rendering criterion is separate from selecting attractive images because image assets can be visually suitable while still failing to appear in the deployed page.

unresolved_candidates.description: A freelancer mentions an FAQ section, but the supplied evidence does not establish client acceptance or the intended FAQ content.
A contact form is proposed and discussed, but the client does not clearly accept it or establish its purpose and fields.
Shopify is excluded, but no specific replacement platform such as WordPress, Elementor, or Netlify is clearly confirmed by the client as a persistent technology choice.
The required availability duration or expiration policy for the free-hosted landing-page link is not established.
